scope: Read-only audit of original synthetic sample, separate from new assistant functionality

source_data_findings.issue: Certificate validity starts after the sample operating week
source_data_findings.consequence: Original answer keys must not be treated as verified operational legality labels.

capability_gaps: Nested pairing/flight JSON requires explicit reshaping into supplied duty blocks

No 28-day flight-hours or sector-dependent duty limit
notes: These findings do not claim all original answer keys are correct or all model training labels are usable.
